name: AirSuite
tagline: Modular 2.0 ATA hyperbaric room with medical-grade BIBS.
description: The OneBase AirSuite is a walk-in hyperbaric room. A modular fibreglass-composite cube that fits through standard doorways and assembles on site, with leather seating, ambient LED lighting, a 4K Android interface, and a medical-grade Built-In Breathing System that delivers oxygen precisely while exhausting CO₂.

sizes.label: Duo
sizes.note: Two-person room with individual seating, headsets and O₂ concentrators.

highlights.title: BIBS oxygen delivery
highlights.body: Synchronised Built-In Breathing System for precision oxygen delivery with active CO₂ exhaustion, keeping the internal environment fresh and sterile.

highlights.title: Dual-control automation
highlights.body: Automated pressure regulation and custom decompression speeds, managed from an Android interface with full app connectivity and 4K entertainment.

highlights.title: Fits through a door
highlights.body: Four segments, each 1100 × 800 × 2000 mm, assemble into a 2.2 × 1.6 × 2.0 m room. No structural works.

highlights.title: Triple-redundant safety
highlights.body: Manual emergency valves, constant pressure monitoring and redundant controls for total operator confidence.

highlights.title: AirBreaks technology
highlights.body: Modulate oxygen and ambient airflow within a session for hyperoxic–hypoxic protocols.

highlights.title: Sensing built in
highlights.body: Air pressure, O₂, CO₂, temperature, humidity, particulates, TVOC and sound pressure, streamed to the OneBase software ecosystem.

specs.label: Oxygen concentrator
specs.value: 958 × 1327 × 480 mm · 118 kg · one per person · PSA 20 L/min @ 4 bar · 93% ± 3% purity

specs.label: Interior
specs.value: Adjustable lay-down chairs, entertainment with individual headsets, RGBW DALI high-density LED for circadian lighting

faqs.q: Does the AirSuite need building work?
faqs.a: No. It ships as four segments that pass through a standard doorway and assemble on site.
The AirSuite is a 2.0 ATA system with automated pressure regulation and custom decompression profiles.
